description: Delete a draft record by id to clean up an abandoned draft. Draft-only — submitted records are frozen and cannot be discarded. Treat a not_found result on discard as effectively idempotent: a draft that is already gone reports not_found rather than a distinct already-discarded error.

draft_id.description: The draft record id to delete.

name: evals_discard_draft

discarded.description: Always true on success — the draft file was removed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No draft exists with the given id (never created, or already discarded). `record_frozen`: The id refers to a submitted (frozen) record, which cannot be discarded. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: evals-mcp-server: discard draft
